events.summary: Speaker A set the team aim: a remote control that is original, trendy and user friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: our aim is to produce a remote control that is original, trendy and user friendly

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a remote that is water resistant, strong and furry.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we should design a remote control that's water resistant, strong and furry

events.summary: Speaker A gave the selling price goal as twenty five Euro.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Our selling price goal is twenty five Euro and profit aim is fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker A gave the profit aim as fifty million Euro.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: and profit aim is fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker A said the team hopes to sell the remote internationally.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we will hope to sell this internationally

events.speaker: C
events.quote: It can't be that hard to put some kind of a noise on it

events.quote: I'm sure we could do that for twenty five Euros a pop

events.summary: Speaker C proposed fewer buttons, because users never use half of them.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: it shouldn't have too many buttons, 'cause I hate that when they have too many buttons

events.summary: Speaker B objected that some buttons, such as B and F, do nothing, which supports fewer buttons.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: B_ button and the F_ button, they don't do anything

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a small screen, like a mobile phone, so the remote has fewer buttons but keeps all functions.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: so it has less buttons but it still has all the functions

events.summary: Speaker A proposed letting users programme their favourite channels, as on a radio.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: so you can programme like your favourite channels
